_comment: TOP-UP run. Continues training/runs/odoo19-agent-4b/adapter on a focused mix.
Use with --init-from, which loads that adapter as the starting weights instead
of the 4-bit base. Without it this trains a fresh adapter and the 40 hours
learning_rate is 2e-5, not the 1e-4 the original run used. A from-scratch rate
on a trained adapter overwrites what it knows: the point here is a nudge toward
two new behaviours, not relearning Odoo.
1 epoch. At ~5,800 samples and an effective batch of 16 that is ~363 steps, so
about 5 hours at the ~53 s/step this card averaged. Probe at ~50 steps before
output_dir and data_dir are separate from the original run on purpose, so a
top-up that goes wrong cannot overwrite the adapter it started from.
